top_signals.title: Radiant Logistics’ latest deal expands its bi-modal broker platform
top_signals.summary:
Radiant Logistics announced it has acquired the Dallas brokerage operations of Whitacre Logistics Services, an intermodal and over-the-road transportation unit that will become part of Radiant Road & Rail.

The post Radiant Logistics’ latest deal expands its bi-modal broker platform appeared first on FreightWaves.

top_signals.title: Hackers hijack Google domains after breaching ccTLD registries
top_signals.summary: Hackers obtained unauthorized HTTPS certificates for several Google domains and hijacked domains in the country-code top-level domains (ccTLDs) for Ghana, American Samoa, and Sierra Leone after compromising third-party operators and modifying authoritative DNS records. [...]
